textRuns.value: Conditional formatting is applied to the 'Margin Target Status' column background (green/amber/red) via the 'Margin Target Status Color' measure. Thresholds: Above target >= +5 pts, At target 0 to +5 pts, Near target 0 to -5 pts, Below target less than -5 pts. Status is shown as text in addition to color so meaning does not rely on color alone.
